title: Tax-free savings newsletter 23
text:
This newsletter is published by HMRC to update stakeholders on the latest news for Individual Savings Account ( ISA ) managers and Child Trust Fund providers.

 Tax-free savings newsletter 23 has articles on: 

 • the reform of ISA rules

 • accurate reporting of Lifetime  ISA  transfers

 • upcoming user research on HMRC’s digital  ISA  service
